page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.7 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Because the instance lacks local NVMe SSD storage, all storage operations must rely on external network-attached storage, which interacts with the 10 Gbps network interface. The 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory makes this instance highly specialized for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power but have a minimal memory footprint.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.u2i-c1m1.4xlarge offers high compute density per unit of memory, making it a cost-effective choice for CPU-bound tasks that do not demand large memory allocations. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, compute-intensive web serving, microservices, and lightweight CI/CD pipelines where parallel processing is required but memory usage remains low.
